svg.title: Webhooks
svg.desc: Webhooks. Notify subscribers by calling their HTTP endpoints, with signatures, retries and idempotency. Step 1, Don't poll, get called: Instead of polling for news, the shop registers a URL once and the provider POSTs each event to it. Step 2, Verify before trusting: The shop recomputes the HMAC over the raw body with the shared secret; a forged POST gets a 401. Step 3, Ack fast, retry failures: The shop queues the event and answers 2xx at once; if it is down, the provider retries with backoff. Step 4, Duplicates and order: The retried evt_a43 is skipped by its ID; the late evt_a42 is older than the state, so it's ignored.

g.text: Instead of polling for news, the shop registers a URL once and the provider POSTs each event to it.
The shop recomputes the HMAC over the raw body with the shared secret; a forged POST gets a 401.
The shop queues the event and answers 2xx at once; if it is down, the provider retries with backoff.
The retried evt_a43 is skipped by its ID; the late evt_a42 is older than the state, so it's ignored.
